finding: The former sky() scaled pixel-axis offsets by CDELT before applying PC, equivalent to CD_ij=PC_ij*CDELT_j. FITS WCS requires CD_ij=CDELT_i*PC_ij. This changes rotated WCS positions when CDELT1 != CDELT2 and PC off-diagonals are nonzero.
